Name: Rohan Kumar Singh

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Embedded Systems Intern, Tata Power. Collaborated with the hardware engineering team to design and test microcontroller-based solutions for smart grid applications. Assisted in developing firmware for data acquisition modules used in power monitoring systems. Conducted debugging and troubleshooting of embedded devices to improve system reliability. Documented testing procedures and prepared detailed reports for review by senior engineers. Participated in weekly team meetings, contributing ideas to optimize sensor integration and data communication protocols.
